{{Quote|We are in an outpost built secretly during the early days of Palpatine's rule. Numerous weapons and ships scheduled for decommission of destruction were rerouted here over the years, repaired and maintained.|[[Ennix Devian]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''RZ7-6113-23 base''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] outpost located on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]]. It was later used by the [[Restored Empire]] as its hidden makeshift headquarters.

==History==
{{Quote|Sir, I think I may have the base. I've got a very large energy spike coming from a specific location consistent with a large settlement. I am unable to achieve visual confirmation, however.|New Republic [[Unidentified ensign|ensign]] to [[Unidentified captain (Endor)|captain]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]]</ref>}}
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] patrolled the area and intercepted two [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s. The ''Endor'' tried to follow the starfighters only to be led into a [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|trap]]. A surface-to-space cannon from the base opened fire and destroyed the New Republic ship.

[[File:Assault_RZ7-6113-23_base.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] assault the base.]]

Shortly after, another New Republic ship, a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser]] commanded by [[Lar Ndigo]], entered the system to investigate the disappearance of the ''Endor''. The base's cannon opened fire and almost destroyed the New Republic ship had Ndigo not ordered the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] be raised at the last minute. The base sent out three [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Nimbus]] starfighters as it readied its cannon to fire once more. The New Republic ship sent out it's [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] in response and a short [[Battle of RZ7-6113-23|dogfight]] ensued. After the A-wings won the encounter, the New Republic ship opened fire on the base and was able to destroy the cannon first before it could let loose a second blast.
